plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: Project-management scaffold + session skills. /pm:pm-scaffold stands up a minimal starter (day-one files only; other folders are created on first write per the stamped CLAUDE.md taxonomy); discovery riffs work into a committed intent + size call before planning; fast-grill paces every grilling round (technical questions to the Astra seat via Ringer, ledgered as rulings; the human answers taste, one-way doors, and splits); whats-next and stepping-away open and close each working session — per-session, per-person logs, several a day is normal — with checkpoint reserved for a session too long to close and reopen; WORKFLOW.md maps the stage chain (Build runs as the library's build-swarm loop by default when a ticket frontier with checks exists, 0.15); verify-before-done gates completion claims on evidence; credential-guard hook blocks committing credential-shaped files; okf and granola-transcript ride along as utility skills.

plugins.name: design-dc
plugins.description: DataCraft design workflow: design-handoff (the crossing brief for claude.ai/design), html-artifacts (rich editorial HTML instead of long markdown), excalidraw-artifacts (HTML artifact → locked Excalidraw markup canvas, and annotation readback), design-sync (component-library sync via the built-in DesignSync tool). Pairs with the separate claude-design bridge plugin.

plugins.name: fm-dc
plugins.description: Agentic FileMaker development: SaXML patching with verify/rollback, DDR analysis, snippet validation, ProofKit and server-connection doctrine, and project scaffolding. Commands /fm-dc:fm-init, fm-scaffold, fm-status, fm-rollback, fm-docs-sync.

plugins.name: ui-test
plugins.description: Agent-run UI tests for FileMaker Pro builds: fm-ui-test splits assertions by evidence channel, writes a typed runner instruction, dispatches a Codex computer-use worker under Ringer, validates the returned receipt (screenshots + on-screen reads) with executed checks, and hands a fresh verifier task the verdict. PASS-OBSERVED / FAIL / BLOCKED outcomes; ships the tool matrix observed on this stack.
